{{Quote|If any of you would like to learn the ways of the Force, to do what Vilas and I can do&mdash;whether you be male or female, noble-born or slave&mdash;come join us. Our settlement is at the bottom of the Great Canyon, only three days' journey from here by foot.|[[Vonnda Ra]]|<ref name="YJK:SA" />}}
The '''Great Canyon''', also known as '''Vass Meindras''',<ref name="SWG" /> was a wide canyon on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It was located just north of the [[Frenzied River]],<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|361|Great Canyon}}</ref> between the [[Red Hills/Legends|Red Hills]] and the [[Northern Lakes]].<ref name="GotORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> A small river surrounded by lush vegetation flowed at the bottom of the canyon.<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
[[File:Vass_Meindras_2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The bottom of the Great Canyon]]
Around the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Witches of Dathomir]] of the [[Great Canyon Clan]] had their settlement at the bottom of the Great Canyon. In [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Brakiss]] set up camp here to search for experienced [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Force Adept|adepts]] to join the [[Second Imperium]]'s [[Shadow Academy]].<ref name="YJK:SA" />
